frontMatter.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Match Night, Two Courts & Juvenile Club
frontMatter.summary: Monday Club Night is back in Claremont Stadium with Grade 7 Mens (Navan ‘B’ vs Drumree), two adult courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).

prev.title: Weekly Badminton Round-Up: Cup Semi-Final Secured & Big League Matches Ahead
prev.summary: A busy week of badminton with hard-fought draws, a Cup win on points for our Grade 6 Mens to reach the Semi-Final, and key league fixtures coming up. Note: No club night on Wednesday 4th March—adult club nights are Monday 2nd and Thursday 5th.
